managed_postgres_finding: PostgreSQL 16 leaves the role creator with a system-granted ADMIN-only membership in the recovery role. A temporary SET/INHERIT grant can be removed, but the ADMIN row remains. Finalizer preflight and postconditions therefore require no effective SET or USAGE and no recovery schema CREATE, rather than no MEMBER row.
